notes.title: v1.8.0 - Mr. Fugagi’s Fish Market
notes.content:
Mr. Fugagi’s Fish Market has been added to the map! Make money from your rare catches or buy rare fish from other players, with this new online feature of Fish & Bubbles. *Limit 3 fish per player listed at one time.

Visit Mr. Fugagi’s Fish Market today, and you may find rare fish being sold!

Other Features Added / Repairs Done:

You can remove fish from your tank, and place them into your bag

Fish no longer stack in the bag/inventory to properly preserve name/size/color

The Bubble King’s “Daily Wheel” has been moved to the Map (it was previously on the main menu)

The wheel is more accurate on what you’ve won (prior it was a few pixels off, resulting in rewards that mismatched if you landed right near the line)

Fishing quality of life has been improved, and it is more clear and functional

The Anubias is less animated (and is being prepped for an overhaul in a future update)

More music has been added to the game, and tracks will play in random order, giving a fresher feel while working on your tank

Some new fish have been added, and they will slowly be released via Mr. Fugagi’s Market

notes.title: v1.4 Autofeeder & Rebalanced Gameplay
notes.content:
Hello Fishtankers,

This update for Fish & Bubbles is much needed! I've recently begun looking at the quality of gameplay and in my opinion it was low, to get just a few fish you would have to wait potentially hours, and for this I needed to adjust it right away!

[b]Gameplay Rebalancing[/b]

The feel I was going for wasn't achieved in the original logic so I've made the following adjustments, and have tested them out and I'm very happy with the results!!

[list]
[*] All prices of fish are 50% of what they used to be
[*]     Guppy 25 (was 50)
[*]     Vivid Guppy 50 (was 100)
[*]     Goldfish 75 (was 150)
[*]     Puffer 125 (was 250)
[*] The Air Pump has been lowered in price
[*]     Sm. Air Pump 250 (was 500)
[*] Fish have up to three chances to increase hunger per game tick (bumping it to 1-3x hunger RNG)
[*] The game's tick rate has been decreased from 30 seconds to 18 seconds (speeds up gameplay)
[/list]

[b]Autofeeder Item[/b]

Coming in at the price of [b]350gp[/b], the autofeeder,

[img]https://fishandbubbles.nyc3.cdn.digitaloceanspaces.com/1.4/autofeeder.png[/img]

Feeds your fish every 12 secs so they don't go hungry.

This helps with sustaining larger tanks and providing easier funds for smaller tanks who are casually playing to rack up coins.

Evenly places flakes above the tank so that your fish are dispersed throughout the tank for better visuals.

Happy tanking,
d4rkd0s
